correctness.rationale: The exact chord and shoelace formulas in angular gaps gamma_i=2pi/m+delta_i yield D_P=(s/4)sum delta²+(c/24)sum delta³+O(||delta||⁴) and D_A=(s c/2)sum delta²+(cos2a/12)sum delta³+O(||delta||⁴), so D_A-2cD_P=-(s²/12)sum delta³+O(||delta||⁴). Strict Jensen uniqueness forces near-minimal D_P into a small regular-gap neighborhood; the sharp constrained cubic norm on sum-zero unit vectors is (m-2)/sqrt(m(m-1)) and has one-vs-rest extrema by two-value multipliers. The Dirichlet(1,...,1) gap density is constant, so the scaled sublevel domain differs from the unit ball by O(sqrt epsilon) in relative volume, proving TV for the gap vector. Uniform cubic approximation gives joint weak convergence and bounded-moment convergence. Projector sixth-moment Wick contractions yield the displayed variance; m=3 gives sqrt3/216. Independent direct sine perturbation checked m=3,4,5,8 including both sharp coefficient and cubic residual, and symbolic variance for m=3.

value.rationale: A natural fixed-side endpoint rare event generates a non-Gaussian joint signed cubic fluctuation after area/perimeter quadratic cancellations; explicit sharp deterministic stability coefficient, support, extremizers and conditional variance are meaningful geometric-probability invariants not supplied by scalar endpoint tails. The already-known conditional unit-ball first-order shape is credited, with the cubic observable the additional content.

final_claim: For fixed m>=3 IID uniform circle vertices, the signed joint area-perimeter deficit R=(A*-A)-2cos(pi/m)(P*-P) has a third-order leading term with optimal local bound |R|/(P*-P)^(3/2) attaining C_m=(2sqrt(sin(pi/m))/3)(m-2)/sqrt(m(m-1)). Conditioned on perimeter deficit <=epsilon, scaled ordered gap deviations converge in total variation to a uniform Euclidean ball in the sum-zero hyperplane; jointly the scaled signed residual converges weakly to -(2sqrt(sin(pi/m))/3)sum_i Z_i^3, supported on ±C_m with variance 8s(m-1)(m-2)/(3m(m+1)(m+3)(m+5)).
limitations: m fixed while epsilon tends to zero, IID uniform arclength vertices; TV only for scaled gap vector and joint weak convergence for signed cubic residual, not TV of its scalar image.
